facts.name: organicmaps
facts.description: 🍃 Organic Maps is a free Android & iOS offline maps app for more than 12M travelers, tourists, hikers, and cyclists. It uses crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data and is developed with love by the community. No ads, no tracking, no data collection, no crapware. Please donate to support the development!
